_doc: The player bot's profile (T-071, player_bot.json personality): the local human's survivor played by the bots' brain. It leads (nobody to follow), so follow / regroup / escort / window holds are off; lead_train (BotTrainer) is its fight while a loop is usable, and plain fight is the fallback (special rounds, no loop). Same keys as the other personality_<char>.json files.
_summary: The agent playing your survivor: trains the horde round the map's loop, leads the squad, shops for itself.
